newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finns more EMU-positive if many states join - poll.
newsitem.headline: Finns more EMU-positive if many states join - poll.

text.p: Finns would be more inclined to take a favourable view of EMU participation if most European Union member countries joined the single currency, according to an opinion poll released on Tuesday.

In all, 42 percent of the 2,409 respondents in the survey said Finland should join if most other EU members did, while 25 percent were against, the Centre for Finnish Business and Policy Studies (EVA) said in a report.
When asked whether Finland should join EMU if Sweden was among those who joined, only 23 percent said yes and 39 percent said no.
Asked simply if Finland should join the single currency from the start, only 21 percent said yes while 40 percent said no.
Slightly over one-third of respondents were undecided on all EMU-questions, EVA said.
The survey was based on written responses collected between November 12, 1996 and January 17, 1997.
